title: cypripedium luteum var. parviflorum
intro: Cypripedium luteum var. parviflorum, commonly known as the small yellow lady's slipper, is a type of terrestrial orchid that is native to certain regions of North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various ailments such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antitumor, and immunomodulatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential uses of Cypripedium luteum var. parviflorum.
